why: Company release confirms the event but changes its nature: Domo will file its 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-07-31 on 2026-09-03 after market close and explicitly does NOT plan to issue a separate earnings release or hold a call. The calendar row's date is right; anyone expecting a press release and a call will find neither.
session_evidence: Company release: 10-Q expected to be filed Thursday 2026-09-03 'after the market closes'; no earnings release and no call - https://www.domo.com/news/press/domo-announces-timing-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027-financial-results-and-provides-transaction-timing-update
where_to_look: This is no longer an operating-results event. On 2026-07-22 Domo agreed to sell substantially all assets and certain liabilities to Progress Software for $400m cash, excluding its NOLs, leaving pro-forma net cash of approximately $246m or $4.84 per share (https://www.domo.com/news/press/domo-announces-agreement-to-sell-substantially-all-assets-and-certain-liabilities-to-progress-software-for-400-million). Spot in the baseline is $3.815. The 10-Q is the primary document that updates every input to that $4.84

Specifically: cash and equivalents, the term-loan balance and any prepayment penalty, deferred revenue (which is a purchase-price-adjustment item), transaction and retention costs accrued, and lease/other liabilities not being assumed

The 10-Q's subsequent-events and going-concern notes, and any change in the expected close date vs Progress's fiscal-year-end-2026 guidance. Progress's own quarterly filing and call commentary is the other side of the same disclosure
Because there is no press release and no call, the disclosure arrives only in the filing text. That is the single cheapest information asymmetry on this list - the wire will not summarise it
Whether the NOL retention has any articulated monetisation plan, since it is the one asset explicitly not sold
already_in_the_wire: The Progress Software asset sale, the $400m headline and the $4.84/share net-cash figure - all press-released 2026-07-22
That there will be no earnings release and no conference call
The June-2026 -37% print; the baseline's 7-event, 18% median reaction history is pre-deal and cannot be used as a base rate for a post-deal, no-call 10-Q filing
